scripts.start: cd artifacts/asateen-game && npm run build && cd ../api-server && node build.mjs && node --enable-source-maps dist/index.mjs
scripts.dev:api: cd artifacts/api-server && node build.mjs && node dist/index.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
